narrative.gap_prioritization_md:
Gaps are prioritized using a formula combining magnitude (distance to peer median) and business impact:
Priority Score = (Peer Median − FCNCA Score) × (Weighting / Category Count) × Business Impact Factor
This formula weights P2 (Customer Experience, 30% of overall) highest, while accounting for category concentration within pillars.
